帝姝的霸道（帝姝的霸道（第22页）“没死，那就自己爬起来，没用的废物。”林罪晃了晃脑袋，用左手撑起身，站了起来。此时的他，全身上下没有一处是完好的。帝姝又看了一眼楚离天，眼里闪过杀意。她伸出手，一只完全由仙力凝聚的大手，掐住楚离天的身体。“给你十分钟时间，若是拿不出证据，那就死。”将楚离天从高空中扔下。楚离天怒吼道，“他的储物袋子里，一定有航儿的东西。”帝姝看向空中，“斩玄，还不出来。”一道漩涡出现，斩玄仙人的身影，从漩涡中走出。他对着帝姝笑了笑。帝姝冷哼一声，“斩玄，你外门长老，一口咬定我徒儿的从者杀了他的儿子。”“林罪的储物袋子里，有他儿子的东西。”“当着你的面，若是他搜不出来任何东西，我会杀了他。”“他侮辱晗儿，不杀他，是给你一个面子，既然你外门长老不想要这个机会，那就公事公办。”“如何？”斩玄笑着看向楚离天，“听到了吗？你可有把握？”楚离天从地上站起身，“我有把握。”帝姝没有废话，林罪腰间的储物袋子落到她的手上。她拉开袋子，倒出里面的东西。除了一柄，两套普通的衣服，什么都没有。帝姝看向神色未变的斩玄。斩玄微微拱手，“帝姝，给我个面子，这次是离天的不对，让他给林罪道个歉，此事就让它过去……”话没有说完。林罪感觉有风吹了吹。斩玄身后的楚离天，一颗脑袋已经和身体分了家。斩玄脸上的笑意消失，随之而来的是阴沉。“帝姝，你怎敢如此。”帝姝一脸不屑，“我说过了，拿不出证据，那就死。”“你的面子，在我这里，不值一提。”“你若是不服，我们，可以现在就打一架。”斩玄的脸上，重新挂上了笑容。“帝姝，你说笑了。”随后，他看向林罪。“林罪，不得不说，你运气很不错。”“时间还长，慢慢玩。”“本座，记住你了。”说完，他带着楚离天的残肢离开。林罪微微皱眉。解决了楚离天一个小患。现在，换成了斩玄这个大患。斩玄想杀了他。不过，他也想杀了斩玄。楚离天想杀他的时候他不出来，帝姝想杀楚离天的时候他就站出来。未来，就看谁先杀死谁。他单膝跪在帝姝面前。“长老，我给妃晗师姐丢脸了，让你和斩玄殿主产生了隔阂。”“隔阂？他算什么东西。”帝姝表情变得严肃，“你没有向楚离天求饶，还让我刮目相看几分。”“若是你求饶，丢了晗儿的面子，就不值得救。”林罪深深躬下身。“我今日，一定努力修炼，师姐和长老已经救过我很多次。”“未来，即使是死，我也不会让妃晗师姐受到任何的伤害。”“为了她，我什么都愿意做。”说完，林罪故作眼前一黑，身影摇摇晃晃，直直往后倒去。……

Emperor Shu's Dominance (Page 22) "If you're not dead, then get up by yourself, you useless loser." Lin Zui shook his head, propped himself up with his left hand, and stood up. At this time, no part of his body was intact. Emperor Shu glanced at Chu Litian again, with murderous intent flashing in her eyes. She stretched out her hand, a big hand completely condensed with fairy power, and pinched Chu Litian's body. "I'll give you ten minutes. , If you can't produce evidence, you will die." Chu Litian was thrown down from the sky. Chu Litian roared, "There must be Hang'er's things in his storage bag." Di Shu looked into the air, "Zhan Xuan, return it. Don't come out." A whirlpool appeared, and the figure of Immortal Zhanxuan walked out of the whirlpool. He smiled at Emperor Shu. Emperor Shu snorted coldly, "Zhanxuan, you outer sect elder insists on killing my disciple's followers. "There are things belonging to his son in Lin Zui's storage bag." "If he can't find anything in front of you, I will kill him." "He insulted Han'er and didn't kill him. Since you don't want this opportunity, let's do it for business." "What?" Zhan Xuan looked at Chu Litian with a smile, "Are you sure?" She stood up and said, "I'm sure." Di Shu didn't say anything, and the storage bag on Lin Zui's waist fell into her hand. She opened the bag and poured out the contents. Except for a handle and two sets of ordinary clothes, Di Shu looked at Zhan Xuan, whose expression did not change. Zhan Xuan slightly handed over his hand, "Di Shu, please give me some respect. It's Li Tian's fault this time. Let him apologize to Lin Zu and let this matter go..." After saying that, Lin Sui felt the wind blowing. Behind Zhan Xuan, Chu Litian's head had separated from his body. The smile on Zhan Xuan's face disappeared, followed by gloom. "Di Shu, how dare you do this." Di Shu said with disdain, "I said, if you can't provide evidence, you will die." "Your face is not worth mentioning here." "If you are not convinced, we can fight now." A smile returned to Xuan's face. "Di Shu, you are joking." Then he looked at Lin Zu. "It's still a long time, so take your time." After that, he took Chu Litian's stump and left. Lin Zui frowned slightly. Now, it was Zhan Xuan who wanted to kill him. He also wanted to kill Zhan Xuan. He didn't come out when Chu Litian wanted to kill him, but he stood up when Di Shu wanted to kill Chu Litian. In the future, it depends on who kills him first. "Elder, I am. It's embarrassing for Senior Sister Feihan and creating a gap between you and Master Zhanxuan." Di Shu's expression became serious, "You didn't ask for mercy from Chu Litian, but you still made me look at him with admiration. "If you beg for mercy and lose Han'er's face, it's not worth saving." Lin Zui bowed deeply. "I will practice hard today. Senior sister and elders have saved me many times." "In the future, I will not let Senior Sister Fei Han be harmed in any way." After saying that, Lin Zui's eyes darkened, and he staggered backwards.
